title: A Torsion-free Supersoluble Group with Trivial Outer Automorphism Group
summary: We give a negative solution to Problem~13.23 of the Kourovka Notebook. We construct a torsion-free group $G$ of Hirsch length $14$ admitting a finite series \[ 1=G_0\triangleleft G_1\triangleleft\cdots\triangleleft G_{14}=G \] in which every $G_i$ is normal in $G$ and every factor is infinite cyclic, but such that $\Out(G)=1$.
